subject: Finexa - Security evidence & buying process - next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Discovery — Finexa / Redwood (post-call recap)

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps: 

- Key drivers: reduce per-query latency for customer search (SLA target <200ms p50), lower embedding costs for personalized search, and keep PII in your VPC for regulated data flows.
- Decision criteria you called out: latency SLOs, SOC 2 / pen test evidence, predictable committed throughput, and commercial terms (reserved capacity + overage caps).

As discussed, could you confirm the stakeholder map so we can prioritize who we should brief and what evidence to prepare? From the call I captured:
- Economic buyer: Alex Johnson (you) — final decision on capacity/commitment
- Procurement: Priya Singh (procurement lead) — contract/PO timing
- Security/Compliance: Michael Reyes — SOC 2 / pen-test questions

Proposed next steps:
1) Share our SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, and a small sample of audit logs for your security team to validate — we can deliver by EOW (Jun 18) if that timeline works.
2) Schedule a 30-min security Q&A with Michael + Neha (our security lead) to walk through controls and retention.
3) Procurement: loop in Priya on contract milestones — propose PO in parallel with technical sign-off.

Can you confirm the stakeholders above and whether Jun 18 delivery works? Also flag if you need an NDA/DPA prior to evidence delivery.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
-- Attachment stub: none

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@finexa.com>, Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@finexa.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Discovery — Finexa / Redwood (stakeholder confirmation)

Ben — thanks for the recap and the clear plan. Confirming stakeholders and timelines below: 

- Economic buyer: Alex Johnson (me) — will sign off once security + procurement thumbs up.
- Procurement: Priya Singh (procurement@finexa.com) — handles SOW/PO and standard redlines. Typical procurement lead time ~2-3 weeks after final SOW.
- Security/Compliance: Michael Reyes (michael.reyes@finexa.com) — will own SOC 2 and pen test validation.

We do require SOC 2 Type II and a high-level pen test summary. A sample of audit logs (exportable CSV/JSON) is helpful. We have an internal DPA; we may need a short NDA for deeper log samples.

Priya — I'm looping you in for procurement cadence. Michael — can we do a 30-min sync next week (Jun 16/17) for a quick controls walkthrough?

Alex
Alex Johnson
VP Product
Finexa

From: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:22:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Discovery — Finexa / Redwood (evidence delivery plan)

Thanks Alex — Priya/Michael, looping Marissa & Neha (on our security/compliance team) to coordinate delivery. 

We can do the following evidence package and timeline: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — redacted as needed — delivery by Thu, Jun 18.
- Pen test executive summary (PDF) — delivery by Thu, Jun 18.
- Sample audit logs (CSV export; single-tenant anonymized) — delivery by Thu, Jun 18 behind an NDA link if required.

Neha will run the 30-min controls Q&A with Michael. Proposed slots: Tue Jun 16 10:00-10:30 or Wed Jun 17 14:00-14:30 PT. Which works best?

Procurement note for Priya: we typically ship an SOW + commercial term sheet. If you can share your standard procurement checklist and any required contract points (SLA credits, data residency, export controls), we'll pre-populate.

If Priya needs the DPA/NDA before logs are shared, we can send a DocuSign link for a short mutual NDA today.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
-- Attachments to be sent: SOC2-report-2025.pdf, pen-test-summary.pdf, audit-logs-sample.csv

From: Priya Singh <priya.s@finexa.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@finexa.com>, Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@finexa.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2026 09:37:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Discovery — Finexa / Redwood (questions on retention + formats)

Ben / Neha — thanks. We're fine with the June 18 package, but a couple of clarifications before you send: 

1) Audit logs: what retention window do you store for request/response logs and admin audit trails? We need clarity on minimum retention (Finexa policy is 90 days) and export formats (CSV, JSON). Also confirm if logs will include any PII — we expect anonymized samples.
2) Pen-test: will the executive summary include CVSS scores and remediation timeline for findings? We don't need full raw reports but want to see severity and mitigations.
3) Contracting: can you share a sample SOW and your standard SLA credit terms? Priya — forwarding our procurement checklist (attached) and a preferred PO timeline.

Also — we typically get SOC 2 reports via a secure link (not email). If you have a secure share (Drive or DocuSign), send that link and we'll route to our compliance reviewers.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Singh
Head of Procurement
Finexa

-- Attachment: Finexa-procurement-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.s@finexa.com>, Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@finexa.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.j@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Discovery — Finexa / Redwood (evidence delivery & next steps)

Priya / Michael / Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final delivery plan and answers below: 

1) Evidence delivery (we've uploaded to a secure Drive folder and started DocuSign for the mutual NDA):
   - SOC2-report-2025.pdf (redacted) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/finexa-evidence (access granted to listed emails)
   - pen-test-summary.pdf — includes CVSS scores and remediation status (high/medium/low)
   - audit-logs-sample.csv — anonymized; format: timestamp, request_id, endpoint, response_code, token_hash

2) Retention & PII: our default request/response logs are retained for 180 days; admin audit trails retained for 2 years. Samples are anonymized; no customer PII will be provided in the exports.

3) Pen-test: the exec summary contains CVSS scores and a remediation timeline; full remediation evidence can be provided under an approved SOW.

4) Contracting: attaching a sample SOW and our standard SLA language. Marissa will follow up with a term sheet for reserved capacity pricing. Priya — if you can share any non-negotiables, we'll incorporate them in the SOW prior to your legal review.

5) Next meetings:
   - Security Q&A (Neha + Michael) — scheduled Wed, Jun 23 14:00 PT (calendar invite forthcoming).
   - Exec sponsor call (Alex + Ben) — Fri, Jun 25 11:00 PT to review commercial terms.

If you confirm receipt of the Drive link and NDA invite, we'll mark the evidence step as delivered.

Best —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0182
-- Attachments: sample-SOW.pdf, standard-SLA-terms.pdf
